baseline_authority: Current authorized fn-107 worktree and index, including untracked implementation files; HEAD is not the source baseline.
index_encoding: SHA-256 of git ls-files --stage -z bytes; index_entries records every entry.

cache_exclusions.reason: Reproducible compiler/package-manager/tool outputs, excluded from archive source identity; generated checked-in source and fixture files remain included.

invariants: Never stage, commit, rewrite the index, create a worktree, or recursively delete.
Original tools/umpire files remain byte-identical in place until the namespace swap; live extraction uses copies.
Archive README/index and nested go.mod metadata are the only additions permitted in frozen trees.
Compare post-gate drift against the authorized dirty baseline, not against clean git status.

allowed_fields: testpilot.SourceLocation.path derived by lowering from the same mapped Query source
frozen_fields: stable scala. and scala.explore. Case namespace components
all historical recorded Runs and their embedded Cases

recompute_in_dependency_order.artifact: IR JSON and deterministic protobuf bytes
recompute_in_dependency_order.formula: Apply exact value substitution in the allowed typed fields, preserve every other field and serialization behavior. Recompute full-file checksum.

Re-lower the transformed captured IR with unchanged IdentityFor inputs. CaseID/ProgramID/ContractID/RunScope stay fixed; mapped SourceLocation.path changes the canonical Case checksum and CaseFingerprint. Compare Program and Contract separately.

SHA256(proto.MarshalOptions{Deterministic:true}.Marshal(candidateModel)) changes with mapped positions/source. Use the resulting digest in IdentityFor("temporal.case", "scala.explore."+set, digest), then rederive Case/Program/Contract IDs, run scope, all identity-derived local names and canonical Case checksum. Freeze candidate ordering, targets, actions, drops, standings and semantic behavior.

Rebuild proposal Model/Case payloads from the mapped candidate, then exact proposal JSON SHA256, digest-regression.json filename and trace source links; never edit existing historical proposals or Runs in place.

Must remain identical: clone Model, clear Source and every Position message, deterministic protobuf encode, SHA256("goir.model/v1" || bytes), format goir.model/v1:sha256:<hex>. Update descriptor matching after namespace rename, not the domain string.
Only newly generated receipts bind newly generated Case identities. R22 replacement separately updates reviewed pinned policy identity; historical receipt/Run bytes remain frozen.

migration_contract.comparison: Task 2 captures immutable original semantics and artifact bytes before any move. The migration adapter starts from that capture, validates every changed field against this finite map and independently recomputes derived values; it never accepts new output as its own expected baseline or erases provenance/hash fields.

proto_rename.freeze: field numbers/types/cardinality, enum numbers, wire meaning and deterministic serialization; compare descriptors structurally after the exact namespace substitution. No Testpilot schema rename.

test_claim_transfers.decision: Retain every producer assertion and the generic realization. Replace jobTable/jobQuery raw checker construction with a small Go-authored Umpire IR fixture admitted by reader.Validate/Build and queried through reader.NewRealizer.Find. No Scala invocation or new model behavior. Public reader data/operations only; no checker-internal import or test-only public constructor.
test_claim_transfers.fixture_equivalence: Pin machine/family, domains and ordering, every row including both running-close alternatives, fact order, starts/ends, identity evidence pairs, action IDs, finishes predicate/trigger, jobOnce/jobRetried paths, and eight/8/8/4096 limits against the task-2 original fixture baseline. Preserve cp.Source job.go/test, identities, evidence mutations and all full-Case/fingerprint assertions; fail transfer on any unexplained semantic difference.

test_claim_transfers.decision: Task 2 captures all seven original typed/keyed Query table/claim/witness facts and both produced Cases under identical identity/realization/source inputs, verifying pairwise full-protobuf equality before archiving the oracle. Task 3 preserves those named cases as fixed semantic golden comparisons against equivalent admitted IR table/Query fixtures; task 5 routes them through the copied producer. Keep each original keyed predicate, schedule, limits, evidence/state fields and abstraction claims in the equivalence record. Do not substitute the R22 Scala execution-pin replacements for these legacy parity inputs. Original typed DSL tests remain unchanged in the archive; live tests use reader admission and lowerer-local access, not reader test-builder exports.
test_claim_transfers.original_preservation: Task 3 adds replacement assertions in the live lowerer and never edits model/go/caseproducer tests. Task 5 omits superseded legacy oracle imports only in the newly copied producer tests.

test_claim_transfers.decision: Move claims into same-package lowerer tests. Obtain equivalent Nexus queries with reader.NewRealizer.Find and use lowerer-local realization conversion. Preserve retry/backoff versus sync path selection for after-backoff (a class with no binding), sound Preflight success, deletion of the completion evidence source, exact nexusOperationCompleted: evidence.kind-unknown error and Produce/Preflight agreement. Carry original test comments and assertions; no production API added for fixture construction.

signature_ownership_transfer.rationale: This is the existing closed-Run diagnostic projection and canonical report encoding, so recordedrun owns it alongside closed-Run evidence. It has no cluster/testing or tooling dependency. The command-specific parser, failure classification and statistical logic stay in umpire-repeat. No new forwarding API or functional-wiring dependency exception.
signature_ownership_transfer.task4: Copy implementation and all tests with comments into recordedrun; update functional consumers to recordedrun. Keep original functional definitions/tests temporarily because the frozen old tools command still imports them; no duplicate live ownership after task 6.
signature_ownership_transfer.task6: During the tools namespace swap, switch the copied umpire-repeat compatibility test to recordedrun.RunSignature(...).Line(), then remove original functional signature definitions/tests after checking all callers. Preserve the original command bytes in tools/umpire0.
